query: SELECT cp.id, cp.empresa, cp.valor, cp.arId, ar.valorLiquido, ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, (CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(12,2)) - CAST(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS valorAReceber FROM cobranca_planilha cp LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON cp.arId = ar.id WHERE cp.empresa LIKE '%RONALDO%' AND cp.ativo = 1
